D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Ed Case leads by 42.8 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 100,004 votes; a one point swing is about 1,168 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +35.2 and D +50.3. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.

D.h: What the ballots so far say
D.t: The early vote has moved this forecast 1.1 points toward Ed Case. Bank it: chase the remaining mail ballots and low propensity voters who have not voted.

R.t: Adriel Lam trails by 42.8 and wins 0% of simulations. Closing it takes about 50,002 voters switching sides, or 100,004 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +50.3 and D +35.2. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.

R.h: What the ballots so far say
